title: Index adjustment / passive-flow Taiwan PIT feasibility receipt

officialTaiwanEvidence.source: TWSE / FTSE Taiwan Index Series basic rules
findings: Detailed review results and execution dates are published after the first Friday close.
Constituent changes become effective after the third Friday close / effective Monday.
Corporate actions and events are explicitly part of index maintenance.
Review result technical notice is published on the 7th trading day of the review month.
After five intervening trading days, changes become effective on the 13th trading day.
Unscheduled constituent changes have separate event rules.

officialTaiwanEvidence.source: TWSE e-shop Taiwan All Market index constituent product
findings: Files include close constituent, pre-open constituent, five-day tracking and technical notices.
Product is subscription/licensing gated; public existence does not prove free historical-byte completeness.

externalFalsificationEvidence.finding: Index effect appears in structural decline; liquidity improvement may help explain attenuation.

externalFalsificationEvidence.source: Greenwood et al., Journal of Finance 2024/2025
externalFalsificationEvidence.finding: S&P 500 addition/deletion abnormal-return effect declined substantially over time despite more passive assets.

externalFalsificationEvidence.source: Kumar et al., Journal of Banking & Finance 2023
externalFalsificationEvidence.finding: Results depend on methodology and true additions/deletions versus transfers across related indices.

frozenRules: Announcement, effective date and passive execution window are separate clocks.
ADD is not a deterministic bullish rule; DELETE is not a deterministic bearish rule.
Historical public methodology cannot fabricate missing constituent states.
Transfers across index families must be separated from true net additions/deletions.
Corporate-action, earnings/news and market/sector controls are mandatory.

maturityDecision.rationale: Official Taiwan index methodology and constituent-product artifacts establish point-in-time data feasibility and explicit announcement/effective-session semantics. No outcome claim is made.
